questions.stem: Why is it important that body temperature does not rise too high?

options.text: Because the body would produce too much sweat
Because blood would become too thick to flow
Because the heart would beat too slowly
Because enzymes could denature and stop catalysing reactions

questions.explanation: If body temperature rises too high, enzymes that control vital chemical reactions can denature. This means they change shape permanently and can no longer function, which can be fatal.
